answer_text: IPS Geo Restriction is based on IP geolocation, not domain, so allowlisting a partner’s domain will not bypass a Brazil block. To permit access, use IP-based rules: create an IPS Allowlist rule and specify the partner’s IP Range as the Destination in the rule. If you’re working with a Geo Restriction rule, ensure the inbound direction is configured to allow Brazil and remember that IPS Geo Restriction does not apply to traffic from Cato SDP Clients.
